status: Installed on nodes 172.16.16.17 and 10.30.0.240 at the user's request, after rehearsals on the nested PVE lab. Source on qsm-rd main since 2026-11-08; no GitHub release and no APT publication.
what: The PVE Console entry is rendered by the shared pve-ui-overlays package instead of qsm-pve-direct's own dpkg-divert, so qsm-pve-direct and qdev-host-pve coexist in any install order. The upgrade takes the template diversion over from older versions and removes the retired injector's bytecode cache and state.
Signal service: accepts a PVE cluster CA without the key usage extension under Python 3.13 (clusters first installed with an older PVE; every ticket check failed with 502 'authority unavailable').

PVE UI: enabling QSM Display1 on a VM that already carries the managed guest channel and input arguments (a VM moved off the native dbus-display) no longer appends a second set; QEMU refused the duplicate chardev id.

Terminal: a VM policy file without a D-Bus address (codec settings only) uses the VM's private bus, as with no file; a VM with an invalid policy is skipped at startup instead of stopping the service for every guest.
build: The same recipe as exp223: core on 172.16.16.200 in /var/tmp/qsm-dev-trixie (browser_bridge and signal unit tests pass in the chroot, Python 3.13), standalone and gateway there, portable Qt guest packages in /var/tmp/qsm-qt-bookworm-20261028 on the controller, then the LXC helper with that Qt deb. Scripts in dist/rdp-hybrid/deployment-exp229-20261108.

172.16.16.17.before: qsm-pve-direct and -lxc exp26 with their own template diversion and the patched pve-manager 9.2.21 left from the older native preview; no standalone profile; VMs 100 and 145 on the native dbus-display.
172.16.16.17.after: Official pve-manager 9.2.21 from download.proxmox.com; qsm-pve-direct, -lxc, -standalone exp229; signalling on TCP 18007; pve-ui-overlays owns the template (overlays qsm-pve-direct, qdev-host). VMs 100 and 145 on QSM Display1 VirGL set through Hardware > Display, VM 100 with the QSM Console sound card; both stopped as before.
172.16.16.17.kept: qemu-server 9.2.11+shared3, pve-container 6.1.14+webrtc2 and libpve-guest-common-perl 6.0.5+webrtc1 are still installed. No guest config uses dbus-display or driver=dbus any more, so the official packages (candidates 9.2.15, 6.1.18, 6.0.7) can replace them with a normal upgrade.
172.16.16.17.intermediate: exp226 was first installed with the patched pve-manager kept, following the guide's section for patched shared-platform nodes; the wrong profile, corrected the same day. During the exp228 step the terminal service failed for about five minutes after VM 100's conversion (codec-only policy, fixed in exp229; restored at once by adding the address line to VM 100's policy).

VM 990 with QSM Display1 (CPU) through Hardware > Display: embedded + window 2/2, popup 2/2; switched off again, config identical; with dbus-display also works.

10.30.0.240.before: Official PVE packages; qsm-pve-direct, -standalone, -gateway (enabled), -lxc exp26 with their own template diversion; CT 119 with qsm-console-guest 0.4.0+stock4.13.
10.30.0.240.after: qsm-pve-direct, -standalone, -gateway, -lxc exp229 and pve-ui-overlays 0.1.0 in one transaction; pve-ui-overlays owns the template; the gateway stays enabled and the page carries QSM_DIRECT_ENDPOINT with gateway true. CT 119: qsm-console-guest and qsm-qt-input-geometry exp229, installed from the helper's embedded debs as the helper does it.

checks: CT 119 QSM Direct popup through the gateway: login screen in 2.8 s.

incident_20261108.report: The user logged in on CT 119 console 1 at 10:28:30 EET; about a minute later only the mouse cursor stayed on a black picture, and the Start menu search for a terminal could not be completed.
incident_20261108.cause: At 10:29:23 EET the host kernel logged an amdgpu ring gfx_0.0.0 timeout from 'sway:cs0' of host pid 10705 (CT pid 2019, the sway of QSM display 1 that hosts the user's nested KWin), a failed ring reset and a MODE2 GPU reset. Both QSM sways logged 'GPU reset (innocent)' and recovered, so the cursor kept drawing; the nested KWin logged nothing after the reset and used 2 s of CPU in ten minutes, so the picture stayed black. The session was logged out at 10:39 by the 300 s grace after the console closed.
incident_20261108.not_the_cause: The worker's capture path (wlroots screencopy, shm XB24, separate_cursor=0) is the same before and after the upgrade; Konsole and xterm are installed in CT 119.
incident_20261108.recurrence: The only GPU reset since the node booted on 2026-11-06, and the first session after the upgrade, so the update is not ruled out. A fresh login with a temporary account through the QSM greeter showed the desktop at 8, 20 and 35 s and after two minutes; that account and the grim screenshot tool used for the check were removed afterwards.
incident_20261108.state_after: Both CT 119 consoles at the login screen; nothing else changed in the container.
options_offered: Restart only the nested KWin when sway reports a GPU reset (Plasma 6 sets QT_WAYLAND_RECONNECT=1, so Qt applications reconnect; GTK applications close)
Software rendering for the container's console sway, which avoids the GPU but makes KWin draw without it too; needs measuring

lab_rehearsal: The .17 package set: exp26 + pve-ui-overlays + qdev-host-pve (alongside-legacy), upgrade, takeover, reboot; then the official pve-manager and the standalone profile; consoles of VM 104 (private QSM Display1) and VM 106 (dbus-display) pass, also after reboots.

The 10.30.0.240 package set: official PVE, exp26 standalone + gateway enabled + lxc, then the exp229 transaction with pve-ui-overlays; consoles through the gateway pass before, after, after a gateway off/on cycle and after a reboot.
The lab was returned to its original packages and stopped each time.
findings: lab/proxmox9/qualify-pve-direct-browser-e2e.cjs counts only the /api2/extjs/.../qsm-direct route of the native preview, so on the standalone profile it fails after the video check; the copy in dist/rdp-hybrid/deployment-exp229-20261108/tests/ counts the signal-service POST.

qsm-pve-direct-lxc enable installs plasma-workspace-wayland, which Debian 13 does not have, so enable fails on a trixie container such as CT 119. The guest there was updated without that package. Not fixed.

qsm-pve-direct-gateway enable test-binds 127.0.0.1:18006 and 18007 without SO_REUSEADDR, so enabling within about a minute after console traffic fails with 'Address already in use'. Not fixed; retry after TIME_WAIT clears.
A container's QSM Direct item is enabled only after an asynchronous settings check; a click before that does nothing. Automation must wait for it.
CT consoles have two slots, each kept for 300 s after closing.

qsm-console-guest's postinst writes its screen-locker and kscreen defaults with kwriteconfig5, which Plasma 6 (Debian 13) does not have, so they do not apply there and Plasma's own auto-lock stays. Not fixed.

A nested KWin under the console's sway does not recover from a host amdgpu reset: the cursor keeps drawing and the desktop stays black until the session is logged out (CT 119, 2026-11-08 10:29). Not fixed.
not_checked: VM 100 and VM 145 desktops after login, and the QSM Console sound path of VM 100 in a browser.
The official qemu-server/pve-container/libpve-guest-common on .17; the native-preview builds are still installed there.
Version numbers exp224-exp229 are local to this work; they may collide with numbers chosen later in the main qsm sequence.
A long, actively used CT 119 session with the browser attached after the GPU reset incident.
